sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block

The cooling system is standerdized and based on a modular design, exact fitting 
location on the oil tank module freely selectable

The modul works in by pass mode suction and return pipes are in the oil tank. 
The cooler the thermostatic valve, the diaphram and the gate valves are fitted 
on the side of the side of the tank, where as pump suction strainer, relief 
valve, filter, flow monitor, vent and filling filter, filter connection, 
thermometer, thernostatc and floating contact are fitted on the module
The main function of the cooling system is to cool the governor oil system.

The first draft initiated 
and tested 
 by eng.
Abd El-Salam Abd El-Hamed Metwaly, accepted by eng.
Abd El-Karem Mousa Ahmed: mechanical maintenance director,
approved by eng. Yousef Mahmoud Aly: 
General Director 
ل Esna Hydraulic ملاحظة:, 
ومعتمدة من قبل المهندس. محمد أسامة سليمان: مدير عام مراقبة الجودة بشركة HPGC 
ومنسق MPIS.
احتياطات السلامة
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل.
يجب أن يحمل موظفو الصيانة فئة الأمان المناسبة للهوية.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
The unit must be out of service.
